what: Make prismis's LLM configuration its own and its keys plain environment variables: services are defined in prismis's own config.toml with `api_key = "env:NAME"`, the apiconf dependency and the read of ~/.config/llm-core/services.toml are removed, a fresh install's first run produces a config that reaches an LLM once the documented key is set, and `migrate-config` carries an existing install's prismis services over so cerebro keeps running.
why: Probed 2026-10-07 on cerebro with an empty config home, following the README Quick Start and the daemon's own next-steps text: the first run writes config.toml, context.md and .env, but `verify` fails with 'Failed to read .../llm-core/services.toml', `migrate-config` says 'Nothing to do', and the OPENAI_API_KEY the README and .env template ask for is never read, because llm_client.py resolves services from llm-core's services.toml and keys through apiconf (a git-only package) from ~/.config/apiconf/config.toml, neither of which anything creates. A new user cannot reach a single prioritized item. The llm-core package was removed on 2026-09-25 (decisions.md, openai-sdk-migration) but its config file and the apiconf key store stayed. The operator also wants one key store across his own tools, not keys in every app.
decided: prismis reads keys only from environment variables, through the `env:NAME` form config.toml already uses for Reddit; it keeps loading ~/.config/prismis/.env at startup (__main__.py does today, and cerebro's systemd unit reads it as EnvironmentFile), and a variable already in the environment wins over .env.

Services live in prismis's config.toml as [services.<name>] tables with base_url, model, api_key and the optional fields the current service schema carries (app_title, app_url); [llm] light_service, deep_service and kind_service name them as today.
apiconf is removed from daemon/pyproject.toml and llm_client.py, and nothing in prismis reads ~/.config/llm-core/ any more; services.toml itself is left in place, since other apps still read it.

The default config a first run writes defines one OpenRouter service, openai/gpt-5.4-nano with api_key = "env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY", the configuration production and every LLM test recording run, so light, deep and kind can share one key; the README, the .env template and the first-run next-steps text all name OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

migrate-config, on a config whose [llm] still names services.toml services, copies those service entries into config.toml with api_key = "env:<PROVIDER>_API_KEY" (the variable name apiconf's provider mapping exports), and is idempotent.

The operator's single key store is bridged outside prismis: the apiconf CLI's `apiconf env prismis` exports the variables at launch on cerebro (cargo is installed there) and in his shell, with an apiconf app profile named prismis.
verify's failure for a missing or keyless service names the config.toml service and the environment variable to set, instead of pointing at make install-config or services.toml.
A test runs the README path from an empty config home: first run, set the key variable, verify, against the local LLM stub, and ends in verify passing.
